title: EvidenceRecord
description: Generalized candidate evidence machine schema (CHP-CORE-027): evidence about ANY subject, not only invocations, with explicit issuer + claim provenance. invocation_id is OPTIONAL — evidence can concern a binding, artifact, effect, or external subject with no invocation. Distinct from the invocation-centric evidence-event.schema.json.

issuer.description: CHP-CORE-027: explicit issuer provenance — who is making this evidentiary statement.

claim_type.description: CHP-CORE-027: the kind of claim this evidence carries.

invocation_id.description: OPTIONAL — present only when the evidence concerns an invocation.
